title: How to Pre-Book Food on Your zingbus Journey: Step-by-Step Guide
summary: Step-by-step guide to pre-booking food on zingbus. Order during or after booking via My Trip. Available on Delhi routes from Rs 99. Meal at your seat, no dhaba stop needed.
body_markdown:
Knowing that food can be ordered for a zingbus journey is one thing. Knowing exactly how to do it, when to do it, and what happens next is what makes the difference between a planned meal at your seat and a rushed dhaba stop at an inconvenient hour. The process has two distinct paths depending on when you decide to add food and how you originally booked your ticket.


## **Pre-Booking Food on zingbus: A Complete Overview**


This guide covers both methods for adding food to a zingbus journey: the checkout path for passengers booking directly, and the My Trip path for passengers who booked through a third-party platform or who decide to add food after their ticket is confirmed. It also covers what the ordering window looks like, what happens on the day of travel, and practical tips that make the service work better.


The[complete food on bus guide](https://www.zingbus.com/blog/zingbus-food-on-bus-intercity-travel-meals/) on zingbus.com covers the full menu, prices, and route list if you want to understand what is available before committing to an order.


# **How to Pre-Book Food on Your zingbus Journey: Both Ordering Paths Explained**


Food on Bus is integrated into the zingbus platform rather than being a separate service. This means the meal booking happens either as part of the ticket booking flow or through the same app you use to manage your journey after confirmation. Neither path requires an additional account or a separate platform.


## **Who Can Pre-Book Food on zingbus**


Before going through the ordering process, it helps to know which passengers can use the service.


Direct zingbus passengers (those who book through the zingbus website or app directly) can add food during the ticket booking process at checkout or at any point after booking through the My Trip section.


OTA passengers (those who booked through a third-party travel platform) cannot access the checkout food option since they completed their booking elsewhere. They can, however, add food after booking through the My Trip section of the zingbus app, as long as they have access to the mobile number used for the booking.


The food option is currently available on six Delhi routes: Delhi to Lucknow, Delhi to Manali, Delhi to Varanasi, Delhi to Katra, Delhi to Gorakhpur, and Delhi to Kanpur.


## **Method 1: Pre-Booking Food During Ticket Booking**


This is the simplest path and available only to passengers booking directly on the zingbus website or app.


1. Search for your route and select your travel date.
2. Choose your seat and proceed to the checkout page.
3. Before completing payment, look for the food option in the checkout interface.
4. Open the food menu and browse the available items.
5. Select the meal you want. The item price is added to your ticket total.
6. Complete the payment for both the ticket and the food together.
7. Your booking confirmation will show the food item as part of the order.


This path is the fastest and ensures the food is secured at the same time as the seat. On popular departure dates, meal slots can fill up, so ordering during checkout avoids the risk of an item being unavailable if you return later.


## **Method 2: Pre-Booking Food After Your Ticket Is Confirmed**


This path is available to both direct zingbus passengers and OTA passengers. The food is added through the My Trip section of the zingbus app.


1. Open the zingbus app on your phone.
2. Log in using the mobile number linked to the booking. This step is important: the booking and the food order must be linked to the same mobile number.
3. Go to the My Trip section. Your confirmed journey will appear here.
4. Open the relevant trip.
5. Select the Food Menu option within the trip details.
6. Choose the meal item you want from the available menu.
7. Complete the payment for the food separately from the original ticket amount.
8. Your food order is confirmed and linked to your booking.


The post-booking food option is particularly useful for passengers who plan travel well in advance but prefer to confirm the meal closer to the travel date, or for those who realise after booking that they want to add food.


## **What Happens After You Pre-Book Food**


Once a food order is confirmed, no further action is needed from the passenger during the journey.


The meal is loaded onto the bus before departure. The onboard marshal manages the food service and brings the meal to the passenger’s seat during the journey. Service typically begins in the first two to three hours of the route, after the bus clears the city traffic. The marshal delivers to the berth without requiring the passenger to signal or move.


The delivery happens at the seat regardless of whether the bus has stopped at a rest point. The passenger does not need to join a queue, go to a serving area, or step off the bus.


## **Tips for Getting the Ordering Process Right**


**Order as early as possible on busy departures.** Weekends, festival periods, and long weekends on popular routes like Delhi to Manali can see meal slots fill up ahead of departure. Ordering during checkout secures your meal before this becomes a concern.


**Check the mobile number**


The food order in My Trip is linked to the booking’s mobile number. Logging in with a different number or searching for the booking on a different account will not surface the trip.


**For OTA passengers, use the app**


The food option for OTA bookings is in the zingbus app’s My Trip section, not on the third-party platform where the ticket was purchased. This is the only route to food access for OTA passengers.


**Choose the meal that suits your route length**


For journeys of 6 to 7 hours like Delhi to Kanpur, a mid-range option in the Rs 149 to Rs 179 range is practical. For longer routes of 12 to 14 hours like Delhi to Manali, the Premium Veg Thali at Rs 249 or a parantha combo provides a more complete dinner.


**One order per passenger**


Food orders are placed individually. For a group journey, each passenger who wants food needs to order separately through their own booking.

## **Frequently Asked Questions**


### **How do I pre-book food on a zingbus journey?**


Food can be pre-booked during ticket checkout on the zingbus platform, or after booking through the My Trip section of the zingbus app using the mobile number linked to the booking.


### **Can I pre-book bus food if I booked through an OTA?**


Yes, OTA-booked passengers can add food through the My Trip section of the zingbus app after their booking is confirmed; the option is not available through the OTA platform itself.


### **When is the last chance to pre-book food on zingbus?**


The food option through My Trip is available until the journey starts; ordering in advance rather than at the last minute is recommended on busy routes where meal slots can fill up.


### **How is the pre-booked food delivered on the bus?**


The marshal delivers the meal to the passenger’s seat during the journey, typically in the first two to three hours after departure; no queue or passenger action is needed after the order is confirmed.


### **What meals can I pre-book on zingbus?**


The zingbus food menu includes 12 vegetarian items from Rs 99 to Rs 249, including a Veg Club Sandwich, Paneer Kathi Roll, rice bowls, parantha combos, Paneer Biryani, and a Premium Veg Thali.


### **Is pre-booked food available on all zingbus routes?**


The food pre-booking option is currently available on Delhi to Lucknow, Delhi to Manali, Delhi to Varanasi, Delhi to Katra, Delhi to Gorakhpur, and Delhi to Kanpur; check the zingbus platform for the latest route availability.
